blocks.content: Indian Railways was nationalized in 1951 and is currently the fourth-largest national railway network in the world by size.

items: Track Gauge Dimensions: Broad Gauge (1.676 m), Metre Gauge (1.000 m), and Narrow Gauge (0.762 m / 0.610 m) are frequently asked in RRB NTPC & Group D.
First Electric Train: Deccan Queen / Victoria Terminus to Kurla, which ran on February 3, 1925.
Railway Zone Headquarters: Matching zones with their respective headquarters (e.g., West Central Railway at Jabalpur, North Eastern Railway at Gorakhpur).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The first passenger train ran between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane on April 16, 1853.
Indian Railways was nationalized in 1951 and is currently the fourth-largest railway network in the world.
The mascot of Indian Railways is 'Bholu', an elephant dressed as a railway guard holding a lamp.
Broad Gauge (1.676 m) accounts for the vast majority of the track route length in India.
South Coast Railway (headquartered at Visakhapatnam) is the 18th and newest railway zone in India.
